title: TUDataset: Benchmark Collection for Graph Learning
summary: This community centers on the TUDataset, a collection of benchmark datasets designed for learning with graphs. The dataset was introduced in a 2020 paper published at the ICML 2020 Workshop on Graph Representation Learning and Beyond (GRL+ 2020). The work is authored by a collaborative team of six researchers, including Christopher Morris, Nils M. Kriege, and Franka Bause.
key_findings: The TUDataset is explicitly defined as a collection of benchmark datasets for learning with graphs.
The paper describing the TUDataset was published in the proceedings of the ICML 2020 Workshop on Graph Representation Learning and Beyond (GRL+ 2020).
Christopher Morris is identified as an author of the TUDataset paper.
Nils M. Kriege is identified as an author of the TUDataset paper.
Franka Bause is identified as an author of the TUDataset paper.
Kristian Kersting, Petra Mutzel, and Marion Neumann are also identified as co-authors of the TUDataset paper.
